description: Workspace scenarios (design §7, frozen interface §14 item 7). Data-only in Milestone A (Task A3) — consumed by the real plain-dir/git-worktree provisioners and harvest in Milestone B (Tasks B1/B2).

scenarios.name: per-directory-retention
scenarios.description: meta/, logs/, out/, harness-state/ survive into the durable store; secrets/ and tmp/ are wiped immediately at terminal; work/ is GC'd under TTL and disk-floor knobs.

scenarios.name: secrets-and-tmp-wiped-at-terminal
scenarios.description: Immediately on reaching a terminal state, secrets/ (0700) and tmp/ (TMPDIR) are wiped.

scenarios.name: input-immutability-violation-detected
scenarios.description: input/ is read-only after setup; a mutation detected at harvest is an integrity violation recorded on the attempt record.

scenarios.name: rejected-never-executed-guarantee
scenarios.description: A provisioning failure is terminal `rejected`, carrying the never-executed guarantee that makes resubmission safe — the line is exec-started in the journal.

scenarios.name: symlink-in-out-escaping-tree-rejected
scenarios.description: Every out/ entry is resolved with O_NOFOLLOW/realpath; a symlink whose target escapes out/ is rejected, not dereferenced — closing the out/creds -> ../secrets/token exfiltration path.

scenarios.name: per-attempt-quota-breach
scenarios.description: A per-attempt cumulative disk quota is enforced DURING execution, not only at harvest.

scenarios.name: spawn-time-env-discipline
scenarios.description: No secret-shaped ambient keys, and no setup-phase credentials in the harness env — the execution phase receives only the launcher's allowlisted environment.

scenarios.name: no-secrets-in-meta-grep
scenarios.description: A journal/attempt-record grep proves no secrets/ byte-content ever lands in meta/ — the shim resolves secret forwards at exec and never writes them to meta/ (§6.1 step 4).

expected.grepPattern: the literal secret value must not appear as a substring of any meta/ file
